title: ClearHead Core Configuration
description: Core configuration schema for ClearHead implementations. Defines settings with semantic meaning shared across all tools. Implementations extend this schema with their own namespaced settings (e.g., cli_*, nvim_*, web_*).

data_dir.description: Global directory for user data and action files. Supports shell expansion (~, $HOME, etc.)

config_dir.description: Global directory for configuration files. Supports shell expansion (~, $HOME, etc.)

state_dir.description: Directory for machine-specific state (CRDT, event log). Keep local even if data_dir syncs via Dropbox etc.

default_file.description: Default action file name. Relative paths are resolved from data_dir.

tag_hierarchies.description: Tag parent-child relationships for implicit context inheritance. When an action is tagged with a child tag it implicitly inherits all ancestor tags. Traversal is transitive: +neovim → +terminal → +computer. Used by all tools for query expansion and by the graph layer to emit contextBroader/contextNarrower triples.

additionalProperties.description: List of child tags that inherit from this parent tag.

default_to_user_scope.description: When true, workspace discovery ignores project-scoped .clearhead directories and only loads user-scoped data from data_dir. Useful when you only want your global inbox regardless of cwd.

additional_workspaces.description: Additional workspace directories to include in the domain model. Each path should point to a directory following the .clearhead layout. Supports shell expansion.

plan_path.description: Directory where plan .ics files are written, laid out flat as <plan_path>/<charter>/<uid>.ics. A CalDAV server (e.g. radicale) can point at this same directory to share plans through the files themselves. The server owns the calendar collection (its .Radicale.props); ClearHead only writes .ics into it. When unset, plans live under the workspace's own <data_root>/plans. Supports shell expansion.
